newsitem.title: POLAND: Underwriter takes all Elektromontaz bonds.
newsitem.headline: Underwriter takes all Elektromontaz bonds.

text.p: Polish state-owned bank Pekao SA, which has underwritten the 13-million-zloty convertible bond issue of construction firm Elektromontaz Export SA, bought all the bonds, Elektromontaz president said on Monday.

"Pekao was authorised to hold talks with investors but it decided to take the issue themselves...it's difficult to say if they plan to sell the bonds on the secondary market," Jerzy Lewandowski told Reuters.
Pekao officials were not immediately available for comment.
Elektromontaz earlier said it wanted to offer 130 bonds due January 1, 2000, to selected investors.
Each bond, carrying an annual eight-percent coupon, would be exchangeable for 20,000 shares.
